svg.title: World map — SCOPE
svg.desc: Real generalized coastlines from Natural Earth 1:50 million. Equirectangular projection, longitude −180 to 180 degrees, latitude 90 to −90 degrees. Includes Antarctica and islands. No country borders.
svg.metadata: Source: Natural Earth, ne_50m_land, public domain. https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/50m-physical-vectors/50m-land/ . Coordinates: x=(longitude+180)*4; y=(90-latitude)*4. Designed for Leaflet CRS.EPSG4326 with image bounds [[-90,-180],[90,180]].
